matches.title: Tierlist of all HC + Evo Towers
matches.snippet: Tierlist of all HC + Evo Towers 9. Brawler. Decent for speedrunning. That's all. 8. Necromancer. Very map and mode dependent, great for HC, VC and PW2, but pretty useless besides that. 7. Accelerator. Outclassed by every DPS tower except Turret and Pursuit. 6. Engineer. Jack Of All Trades, Master Of None. Struggles in early-game, mid-game and late-game, very support-unfriendly, was useful in LHC and LFM, but not in their modern versions. 5. Operator. Extremely good early, and holds up pretty well till the late game, but has alternatives like G Soldier, which can be even better. 4. Enforcer. Map and modes dependent (sucks in Frost, shines at Pizza Party and Fallen). Crazy damage and CE plus stuns, though short range. 3. Hacker. The only good HC tower. Multiple strong abilities, very versatile and useful, can increase your DPS drastically with it's clones and doesn't even need to be upgraded to level 5, but is very expensiive and loadout-dependent. 2. Juggernaut. Extremely good for mini/final boss/bosses and for overall damage on Bottom Path, and very strong support and Cost Efficient on Top Path + has hidden and flying/lead. Kingpin. Crazy DPS, strong eco, versatility, 2 detections + 1 semi-detection. Good practically everywhere.

matches.title: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop
matches.snippet: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop No seriously, it used to look like a good choice but now it just looks so incredibly grindy when other, actually viable evos came around. Jugg is quite literally just good for it's "DPS", which you have to pay half a million just to even make it a reasonable choice. It's not a bad tower, but it's heavily outclassed by other evos like Kingpin and the recent Enforcer. Not only that, but the "10k DPS" claim is sheer exaggeration. no one, especially a solo player where it's most efficient will have many supports, but even if they do get all the specs somehow, your loadout is literally just Juggernaut and Friends. You should not complain about the game, or modes in general being boring or "bad" if your playstyle is being Elon musk for 20 waves and placing Jugg. I don't hate Jugg. It's a good tower, but it's just incredibly brain-dead to use. saying your favourite tower is Jugg is the equivalent of saying "infinity + 1". Again, it's good for some hard modes like Voidcore. But I am not bringing jugg to play frost.

matches.title: Should tds have 6 tower slots
matches.snippet: Should tds have 6 tower slots I've played alot of tower defense games and one of the things I appreciate in those games is the variety of towers that you can use. It allows for diversity and strategising. Tds doesn't really have this. The game has been for awhile now been moving towards" generalist" towers. Towers that basically do everything you need them to do. I think if we had more options for towers it would make the game more engaging. Now im not saying just add a 6th tower slot and call it a day. Hell no, we need at least 3 balance testings on a priv before it goes public. Mostly its just moving around detections for towers and slight adjustment for a few towers like mini who wouldn't really benefit much. Gamemodes too. But its mostly just hp increases. Now there are a few pros I've thought of and a few cons. First off for pros: more tower diversity and synergies. There are a handful of towers that usually get shafted because they have a neiche but there's another tower simmilar that's a generalist or a dps. When you have an extra slot and a few other motivators like generalist nerf as mentioned above these towers will feal better 2 randoms won't have an excuse to have the most dogshit loadouts. I just think with 6 slots its easier to cover your weaknesses. You already need farm and a support so you are limited to 3 towers to choose from. Now for cons 1) towers balanced

verified_top_matches.title: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop
verified_top_matches.snippet: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop No seriously, it used to look like a good choice but now it just looks so incredibly grindy when other, actually viable evos came around. Jugg is quite literally just good for it's "DPS", which you have to pay half a million just to even make it a reasonable choice. It's not a bad tower, but it's heavily outclassed by other evos like Kingpin and the recent Enforcer. Not only that, but the "10k DPS" claim is sheer exaggeration. no one, especially a solo player where it's most efficient will have many supports, but even if they do get all the specs somehow, your loadout is literally just Juggernaut and Friends. You should not complain about the game, or modes in general being boring or "bad" if your playstyle is being Elon musk for 20 waves and placing Jugg. I don't hate Jugg. It's a good tower, but it's just incredibly brain-dead to use. saying your favourite tower is Jugg is the equivalent of saying "infinity + 1". Again, it's good for some hard modes like Voidcore. But I am not bringing jugg to play frost.

verified_top_matches.title: Should tds have 6 tower slots
verified_top_matches.snippet: Should tds have 6 tower slots I've played alot of tower defense games and one of the things I appreciate in those games is the variety of towers that you can use. It allows for diversity and strategising. Tds doesn't really have this. The game has been for awhile now been moving towards" generalist" towers. Towers that basically do everything you need them to do. I think if we had more options for towers it would make the game more engaging. Now im not saying just add a 6th tower slot and call it a day. Hell no, we need at least 3 balance testings on a priv before it goes public. Mostly its just moving around detections for towers and slight adjustment for a few towers like mini who wouldn't really benefit much. Gamemodes too. But its mostly just hp increases. Now there are a few pros I've thought of and a few cons. First off for pros: more tower diversity and synergies. There are a handful of towers that usually get shafted because they have a neiche but there's another tower simmilar that's a generalist or a dps. When you have an extra slot and a few other motivators like generalist nerf as mentioned above these towers will feal better 2 randoms won't have an excuse to have the most dogshit loadouts. I just think with 6 slots its easier to cover your weaknesses. You already need farm and a support so you are limited to 3 towers to choose from. Now for cons 1) towers balanced
